written: after the census and the admission tables, before any score; one concrete next increment per candidate

T10.name: suppression relief: remove-suppression (action 7) for suppressed own infantry

conditions.observable: keep and the action 7 listing are seat fields; the census found action 7 listed only while keep is 1 (1,709 H0 and 700 HH unit-decisions, none with keep 0)
conditions.action: listed in valid_actions, never issued by any policy; its effect is undocumented: a one- or two-session probe
conditions.general: infantry in 47 of 50 scenarios; no scenario, map, unit or coordinate
conditions.mechanism: keep and keep_remain_time, and the return of move and shoot listings, are directly observed
conditions.small: an add-on that acts only on suppressed infantry, which baseline-v2 cannot command

T10.P_source: census opportunity flag 'scan remove-suppression listed while suppressed' of 16 H0 sides

T11.name: direct-fire target priority: prefer the listed target most likely to be destroyed

conditions.observable: listed shoot options and visible enemy blood are seat fields
conditions.action: shoot (2), executed in every baseline game
conditions.general: direct fire in every scenario (tanks in 50 of 50, Sprint 1 census)
conditions.mechanism: chosen targets and destroyed units are recorded per shot
conditions.small: an offline replay, then two head-to-head sessions

T11.evidence: of baseline-v2's shots, 368 of 432 (H0) and 267 of 319 (HH) had two or more targets listed, and 127 and 97 had a listed target with lower blood than the chosen one
T11.relation: distinct from TO-1, which assigns one target among colliding shooters; T11 chooses among targets for one shooter
T11.G_source: Sprint 1 census archetype presence '2.0 tank' of 50
T11.P_source: census opportunity flag 'scan shot with two or more targets' of 16 H0 sides

T12.name: objective-zone dispersion: spread stacked holders of a held objective over adjacent hexes

conditions.observable: own units' hexes and stack field and the objective flags are seat fields
conditions.action: one-hex moves, executed in every baseline game; the documented rule that an objective cannot be captured while an enemy ground unit stands on it or next to it is untested here
conditions.mechanism: the stack field and the objective flag are direct; damage to holders needs an acting opponent
conditions.small: an offline count, then one deterministic and two head-to-head sessions

T12.evidence: stationary, stacked holders on objectives took 40 of 177 ground damage events (64 of 285 damage points) in 10 of 16 H0 sides and 10 of 130 events in HH; stacked victims in general took 112 of 177 (H0) and 70 of 130 (HH) ground events
T12.relation: local formation after capture, not allocation; but a dispersed unit is no longer on an objective, so baseline-v2 would send it elsewhere unless its later moves are withheld (the T9 interaction)
T12.G_source: census S.presence_all 'T7-C ground vehicle or infantry' of 50
T12.P_source: admission tables H0 'sides_with_a_stationary_stacked_hit_on_an_objective' of 16 H0 sides

not_admitted.close-combat avoidance: 71 of 205 (H0) and 55 of 158 (HH) damage events were at distance 0, every attacker seen before; it is a route-entry case of threat-aware movement and is covered by T6's gate (an enemy's own hex is inside its envelope)
not_admitted.aircraft stand-off: 13 aircraft events in H0 (4 sides), all while not moving, and 3 in HH: a T6 or T8 case for one archetype, too rare for a family of its own
not_admitted.idle units with an enemy visible: the large idle counts are artillery (T4, shelved) and vehicles on held objectives (T12's population); no separate mechanism
not_admitted.objective losses: 40 (H0) and 26 (HH) losses of held objectives, by rule never with an own unit on the hex; the actionable part is T12's denial by adjacent holders

T2.hypothesis: carrying infantry on a co-located infantry fighting vehicle to its objective and dismounting there lets infantry reach objectives they cannot reach on foot within the game
T2.trigger: at a play decision, an own infantry unit and an own infantry fighting vehicle in the same hex, both stationary, with embark (3) listed for the infantry on that vehicle
T2.action: embark {actor, obj_id: infantry, type 3, target_obj_id: vehicle}; withhold the vehicle's baseline-v2 move until the 75-step transition ends; let baseline-v2 drive it; when it has stopped at an objective and the stop transition has ended, disembark {actor, obj_id: vehicle, type 4, target_obj_id: infantry} if listed and the hex holds fewer than four own ground units
T2.mechanism: embark accepted, the infantry moves to passengers, the carrier keeps vehicle speed, disembark accepted, the infantry stands on the objective and can hold it
T2.offline: on H0, HH and HI: first-play co-location opportunities, the free-flow time each would save (H0 infantry orders: median 2,304 steps, 20 of 51 unable to arrive; vehicles median 140), and how often the destination hex already holds four own ground units
T2.engine_probe: one deterministic session against the inert control in a scenario where embark is listed for infantry at the first play decision; a second only if the first has no such pair
T2.risk: the stacking limit voids a disembark silently (as it voided splits); a loaded carrier lost costs its passengers; the 75-step hold delays the carrier
T2.stop: embark or disembark refused or voided; the carrier's speed or baseline-v2's orders for it change beyond the hold; the dismounted infantry cannot occupy
T2.negative_teaches: transport is not usable with baseline-v2's movement on engine 4.1.0; T2 reduces to infantry defence on foot
T2.to_ab: embark, carry and disembark executed with at most two 75-step transitions of overhead, and infantry standing on objectives they could not reach on foot

T3.hypothesis: remembering enemies seen in the last 300 steps extends a threat gate to attackers out of view at the moment of the order
T3.trigger: an enemy seen within the last 300 steps but not now, whose last-seen envelope covers a route
T3.action: none of its own: an input of T6's gate
T3.mechanism: fewer damage events from attackers out of view at the event
T3.offline: the census already measures the stake: 15 of 205 (H0) and 4 of 158 (HH) events from attackers unseen at the event but seen within 300 steps; 188 and 154 from attackers in view
T3.engine_probe: none of its own; it would ride on a T6 screen
T3.stop: already met in the corpus: fewer than one such event per side-game
T3.negative_teaches: the current view is enough for threat awareness
T3.to_ab: only as part of a T6 candidate

T5.hypothesis: guide-capable units direct infantry fighting vehicles' heavy missiles at targets the vehicle cannot see
T5.trigger: guided fire (9) listed for an own unit
T5.offline: the census: guided fire listed in 1 H0 decision and none in HH or HI, although 61 guide-capable units were present at the first H0 play decision; the listing needs a stationary guide seeing a target in a ready vehicle's range, and unmanned ground vehicles never dismount under baseline-v2
T5.engine_probe: none can be expected to produce a listing without first changing transport and positioning
T5.stop: already met: the listing does not occur
T5.negative_teaches: no guided-fire line without transport and dismounting

T6.hypothesis: withholding a baseline-v2 move that would carry a ground unit from outside every visible enemy's direct-fire envelope into one, until the threat leaves view or a short hold ends, reduces damage to moving units without delaying objective capture beyond a bound
T6.trigger: an own ground unit for which baseline-v2 emits a move this decision; its hex is outside the published direct-fire range (for its class) of every visible enemy; at least one of the first five hexes of the ordered route is inside one; its current hold episode is shorter than 150 steps; it was not released from a hold in the last 300 steps
T6.action: drop that move for this decision; no new action type, routes unchanged
T6.mechanism: units stop walking into observed fire while the threat is in view; damage on moving units falls; each hold lasts at most 150 steps
T6.offline: the gate as a shadow on H0 and HH: gated orders, units, hold lengths to release (first gate of each episode only, since later states are counterfactual), how many gated units were baseline-v2's eventual capturers, and the damage that followed the gated orders on the recorded trajectories (threat-exposed orders followed by damage within 300 steps: 88 of 230 in H0, 101 of 200 in HH)
T6.engine_probe: two sessions head to head against baseline-v2 in 2130511121, both seat orders (the HH configuration), mechanism endpoints only: gates executed, damage to gated units during and within 300 steps after the hold against the HH rate, first-ownership steps against HH
T6.risk: T9-like withholding that delays capture (bounded by the hold limit) or leaves units in the open; no engine risk (no new action)
T6.stop: the gate fires fewer than 10 times per side-game; gated units are damaged at or above the HH rate; any objective first owned later than in all four HH games
T6.negative_teaches: waiting at the edge of observed fire does not avoid damage in this engine (the threat comes on), closing the timing branch of T6; route choice and formation remain
T6.to_ab: damage per gated order at most half the HH rate in the probe, with no objective first owned later than its HH range

T7-C.hypothesis: a concealed unit's move (and shot) is accepted and ends concealment without delay, as documented
T7-C.trigger: the deterministic P-A configuration (1910631192 C3, candidate blue against the inert control), whose concealment orders Sprint 6 reproduced exactly
T7-C.action: a diagnostic hook command, not baseline-v2 behaviour: after concealment has completed, a one-hex move for one concealed vehicle at a fixed decision; and a shot from a concealed unit if one ever lists a target
T7-C.mechanism: the order is accepted and move_state leaves 4 at once
T7-C.offline: already done: no on-policy witness (Sprint 7); the census adds E3b exposure of 1 unit (6 actions) in H0 and none in HH, and an empty benefit channel: no damage event on a concealable unit in H0, 4 in HH (2 units), none by a ground attacker beyond half its observation distance
T7-C.engine_probe: one deterministic session; the fire exit needs a configuration where a concealed unit lists a target (none did in the P-A game), so possibly a second
T7-C.risk: an injected sequence baseline-v2 never produces; its result says nothing about on-policy frequency or benefit
T7-C.stop: the move is refused or concealment persists after it
T7-C.negative_teaches: exit is not free, so concealment conflicts with any later order
T7-C.to_ab: even a positive exit result leaves nothing for an A/B to measure until a benefit channel exists: the census shows idle concealable units are almost never fired at

T8.hypothesis: changing a helicopter's altitude reduces its exposure while it hovers
T8.trigger: an own helicopter not moving with an enemy ground unit visible and change altitude (16) listed
T8.action: change altitude to a listed level
T8.mechanism: different altitude, different observation and damage modifiers
T8.offline: the census: change altitude listed in 6,957 H0 decisions; 13 aircraft damage events in H0 (4 sides), all while not moving, 13 aircraft lost; 3 in HH
T8.engine_probe: one deterministic session for the transition; the exposure effect needs an acting opponent
T8.risk: the altitude effect is documented for transport helicopters, not for attack helicopters
T8.stop: the transition is refused or changes neither observation nor damage
T8.negative_teaches: altitude does not protect attack helicopters
T8.to_ab: lower aircraft damage in head-to-head games

TO-1.offline: published: S1 owner changes in 2 of 8 replay-corpus games
TO-1.engine_probe: the registered next step is the -2 prevalence rerun, 360 diagnostic games
TO-1.risk: large campaign for a rare situation
TO-1.negative_teaches: the collision is too rare to matter

T10.hypothesis: action 7 issued to a suppressed own infantry unit ends its suppression early and restores movement and fire
T10.trigger: an own infantry unit with keep 1 and action 7 listed
T10.mechanism: keep returns to 0 (at once or after a delay); move and shoot are listed again
T10.offline: the census: infantry suppression onsets 15 in H0 (6 of 16 sides) and 4 in HH; infantry damage events 5 in H0 (1 on an already suppressed unit) and none in HH
T10.engine_probe: head-to-head sessions in a configuration with infantry suppression; an add-on that never changes a baseline-v2 action
T10.risk: an undocumented cost of the action
T10.negative_teaches: the action is useless; the family closes
T10.to_ab: suppression ended at once and infantry fire restored, with enough events per game to matter

T11.hypothesis: preferring, among a shooter's listed targets, the one most likely to be destroyed completes kills earlier and removes enemy shooters sooner
T11.trigger: baseline-v2 emits a shot for a unit whose listed options include a target with lower blood than its choice
T11.action: the listed option on the lowest-blood target, highest attack level among its options; baseline-v2's same-step target reservation unchanged
T11.mechanism: more destroyed enemy units per shot
T11.offline: replay on H0 and HH: changed shots (127 and 97 candidates), the attack level given up by each change, interactions with the shoot reservation, and the expected kill probability per changed shot from the published damage tables
T11.engine_probe: two head-to-head sessions in 2130511121, both seat orders: kills per changed shot against baseline-v2's shots in the same games; refusals
T11.risk: a lower attack level on the new target lowers damage per shot
T11.stop: fewer than 10 changed shots per side-game, or kills per changed shot not above baseline-v2's
T11.negative_teaches: the highest-attack-level rule is at least as good; this fire-choice rule closes
T11.to_ab: kills per changed shot clearly above baseline-v2's same-game rate

T12.hypothesis: moving all but one stacked holder of a held objective to free adjacent hexes keeps the objective denied and removes the stacked-target modifier
T12.trigger: a held objective with two or more idle own ground units on its hex and a passable adjacent hex with fewer than four own ground units
T12.action: a one-hex move for each extra unit; baseline-v2's later moves for dispersed units withheld while the objective is held
T12.mechanism: stack cleared, objective still held, fewer damage events on holders
T12.offline: trigger occurrences and timing on H0 and HH; adjacency and passability
T12.engine_probe: one deterministic session for execution, then two head-to-head sessions for denial and damage
T12.risk: the withholding interaction that shelved T9; the denial rule is untested
T12.stop: an objective is captured while a dispersed holder stands next to it
T12.to_ab: denial verified and damage to holders reduced
